text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
MostPopulous(x) ::: x is the most populous city.
HostedEvent(x, y) ::: x hosted event y.
HasHost(x, y) ::: x has hosted y.
RankedAmong(x, y) ::: x is ranked among y.
Universities(x) ::: x are universities.
ConsistentlyRanked(x) ::: x consistently rank among the best.
Premises:
Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China. ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
Beijing is the world's most populous national capital city. ::: Beijing is the most populous capital city.
Beijing is located in Northern China. ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics Games. ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and Paralympics.
Beijing has hosted both the Summer and Winter Olympics, along with the Summer and Winter Paralympics. ::: Beijing has hosted both Summer and Winter Olympics and Paralympics.
Many of Beijing's 91 universities consistently rank among the best in the Asia-Pacific and the world. ::: Many of Beijing's universities consistently rank among the best.
Conclusion:
LocatedIn(Beijing, SouthernChina) ::: Beijing is located in southern China.
